_comment: Generic device-mock presets. Each preset is deep-merged onto `base`, then validated (schema: docs/device-mock.md). Presets are data: add one here, or put team/feature presets in a JSON file listed in LOMA_DEVICE_MOCK_PRESETS. Feature-specific /init payloads belong in a --scenario-file / --patch-file. Never put customer ids, keys or URLs in this file.

passthrough.description: No changes: forward everything and log it. Use to check the app reaches the mock at all.

no_flows.description: /init with data.flows emptied, so live in-app campaigns do not cover the screen.

slow_images.description: Images (png/jpg/webp/gif) in /init delayed 9s, so loading states stay on screen.

failing_images.description: Images in /init fail with 404 after 2s (error/fallback state).

hanging_images.description: Images in /init delayed 25s (past typical client timeouts and loader caps).

slow_init.description: /sdk/init answered by the upstream after an extra 8s delay.

init_error.description: /sdk/init fails with 500 (no upstream call). Other API calls pass through.

api_down.description: Every API call fails with 503 after 1s (backend outage).
